prompt: Stage 3-1, level 6, 24 gold. Your bench is full. The shop shows the third copy of your 2-cost ranged carry, which would make it 2-star, but you cannot buy with no bench space. Two 1-cost assassins from stage 2 sit on the bench unused. What do you do?

options.label: Sell one of the unused 1-cost assassins (you get the 1 gold back) and buy the carry copy
Skip the copy: selling loses gold, and the carry will come around again
Sell the 2-star tank on the board to make room
Refresh the shop so the copy goes away and you can stop worrying about it

explanation:
Selling a 1-star returns exactly what you paid, so the assassin costs nothing to turn back into 1 gold and a bench slot. That slot lets you buy the third copy, and the three carries merge into a 2-star that goes straight onto the board. A bench full of units you are not using is not 'options'; it is the reason you cannot buy the upgrade in front of you.

'Selling loses gold' is only true of 2-stars of 2-cost or higher. Selling the 2-star tank from the board is backwards: that unit is winning your fights.
principle: Bench space is a resource. Sell what you are not going to play so the upgrade has somewhere to land.
commonMistake: Hoarding stage-2 leftovers on the bench until the copy of a real unit cannot be bought.
hint: Which bench units have not been on the board for two rounds, and what does each one sell for?
